label: Renost
note: Reindeer milk is very rich (about 22 % fat, 10 % protein) but a doe gives about 1.5 cups a day, so production is tiny; it was often taken in coffee instead of cream.

about.text: Renost is the traditional cheese of the Sámi, made from reindeer milk in northern Scandinavia. Historically the curdled milk was poured into a reindeer stomach and hung in the open air; today the few makers use linen cloths, and the cheese turns hard and grainy in the cold and is sometimes smoked.
